$description: Palette generation rules — how `generate` derives every core palette slot from the brand inputs. Designer-editable data, no code. Two methods: `contrast` slots are solved by Leonardo on the key colour's scale to the per-mode `ratio` (vs the slot's `against` token from targets.json, floored at its target — so a stock-matching ratio request can never undercut the accessibility floor); `mix` slots are percentage tints (mix toward white) / shades (mix toward black) of a brand — the 1.x `$ct-colors-default` derivation recipe verbatim. `key`/`of` name a brand (brand1-3) or `default` (the slot's committed stock value per mode — the status colours and focus, literal in 1.x, generate from their own defaults). The `ratio` values are the STOCK palette's measured ratios, so generating from the stock brands reproduces the stock design's contrast structure; the three floored dark slots (border 1.16, interaction-focus 2.32, error 2.97) are the known failures generation fixes.
